workload.description: PyQED full multicenter one-electron Breit-Pauli pVxp AO tensor for formaldehyde compared with PySOC 2.3.0 / MolSOC 0.1.
workload.method: Unscreened one-electron nuclear SOC operator; PySOC MolSOC ONE model
workload.system: CH2O at the geometry bundled in PySOC examples/ch2o_tddftb; charge 0; spin 0; PySOC mio-1-1 fitted Gaussian basis; 10 spherical AOs

parameters.basis_mapping: PySOC unnormalized fitted primitives mapped to normalized libcint AOs and transformed back to the raw PySOC AO convention

execution.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 MPLCONFIGDIR=/private/tmp/matplotlib-codex PYTHONPATH=. python benchmarks/ch2o-soc-pysoc/run.py --input benchmarks/ch2o-soc-pysoc/input.json --reference benchmarks/ch2o-soc-pysoc/pysoc-reference.json --output benchmarks/ch2o-soc-pysoc/raw-output.json --figure-prefix benchmarks/ch2o-soc-pysoc/soc-integral-comparison

validation.reference: PySOC 2.3.0 / MolSOC 0.1 commit 1a520c682f4851a8ec6e551a04ec5cc89ebc2894, bundled examples/ch2o_tddftb, MolSOC ONE AO integrals
validation.quantity: relative Frobenius norm of the AO pVxp residual

notes: Correctness validation only; no timing was measured. The source tree was dirty, so this is a development-snapshot record. The official Gaussian path requires proprietary rwfdump and was not used. The open-source MolSOC AO stage completed normally; a later optional soc_td transition-dipole stage segfault is unrelated and its output is excluded. The claim does not extend to PySOC LR-TDDFT/TD-DFTB state couplings or PyQED CASCI state couplings.
